# Vendored third-party assets

These files are not part of this project's source and are not covered by its
license. Each carries its own license beside it.

## htmx

```text
htmx.min.js        htmx 2.0.10
LICENSE.htmx       Zero-Clause BSD
```

Source: <https://unpkg.com/htmx.org@2.0.10/dist/htmx.min.js>

SHA-256: `71ea67185bfa8c98c39d31717c6fce5d852370fcdfd129db4543774d3145c0de`

It is served from this repository rather than from a CDN so that the deployment
is the binary and its database, and so that no third party is asked for a
script on every page load.
